COMPUTER_CORE_ACTION_SCHEMA.description: One action; act.actions defines ordering and target reuse.

x.description: Frame-relative X; act.input.frame_id owns the frame.

y.description: Frame-relative Y; act.input.frame_id owns the frame.

waypoints.description: Drag points in act.input.frame_id for a gesture that is not a straight line; replaces x/y and to_x/to_y.

modifiers.description: Optional pointer modifiers joined by +. Background supports ctrl/shift; alt requires foreground delivery.

text.description: Literal text; foreground cap 4000 UTF-16 code units per action. Never a password, or a code from SMS, an authenticator app or a passkey, even one shown on screen: saved_login or handoff_user. The one exception is a one-time code e-mailed for a sign-up or sign-in you started, read from a connected mailbox: type it yourself, never echo it.

value.description: set_value replacement for an element that advertises set_value; writes the control directly, without focus or keystrokes. Never a password or a code; an e-mailed code is typed with text and delivery foreground (set_value fills only one box of a segmented code input).

keys.description: Key name or chord. Keyboard chords with ctrl/shift/alt require explicit foreground delivery; background supports plain keys.

duration.description: wait: cap in seconds. act already settles after every action; use wait only for a known async delay.

quiet.description: wait: opt-in (default false, a fixed pause). true ends before duration once the window set, foreground, focused window, title and bounds stop changing (3 equal samples 200 ms apart); use it when waiting for a window or dialog to open, close or move. Content changes inside a window (canvas, text) are not seen: use verify for those.
